_comment: No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility is available, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Quice Food Industries Limited was incorporated in Karachi as a private limited company in 1990 and converted into a public limited company in December 1993. Its shares trade on the Pakistan Stock Exchange under the symbol QUICE.
headOffice: WS7, Madina Palace, Mezzanine Floor, Faran Co-operative Society, Dhoraji Colony, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (quice.com.pk: company-information), read 2026-10-17. No product description or telephone number is published on the pages reachable from the site, so the description covers incorporation and listing only. Note: an older page on the same site gives 1980 as the date the business was established, which conflicts with the 1990 incorporation date used here.
